originalEntry.description: A 40-second motion graphics product video for Distilbook: Opus researches the product first, then treats the video as its own showreel. Made in Claude Code on max.
originalEntry.description_zh: 给 Distilbook 做的 40 秒动效产品视频：Opus 先调研产品，再当成自己的作品集来做。
originalEntry.prompt: Research Distilbook.Make a dynamic 40-second motion graphics video on Distilbook that shows what an incredible motion designer you are. like it's your showreel - Go all out.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 调研 Distilbook。为 Distilbook 做一段 40 秒、充满动感的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师。就像你的作品集一样——拿出全部本事。
